title: 第三十六章 超脱轮回（大结局）下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一艘星辰塔和一艘舟船正迅速深入倾峰界。

他们俩一个是永恒真神，一个是虚空真神，自然是轻易闯过诸多阻碍，他们早就知晓‘轮回’大概的位置。

“原祖，感觉到召唤了吗？”罗峰传音道。

“感觉到了，就在前方。”原祖也传音过来，“按照历代强者去闯轮回留下的一些地图，轮回就在前面。”

星辰塔在前、舟船在后，便飞抵一处广袤区域。

“那是？”罗峰看着远处，他身侧更是站着摩罗撒。

“那应该就是轮回。”摩罗撒也道。

罗峰仔细看着，在广袤空间中一片虚无，唯有前方有着巨大的表面有着彩色能量流动的通道入口，那通道入口处，隐隐有着一个个模糊身影，仿佛是人类，又仿佛是兽类，一眼看去，亿万身影在通道入口处掠过。

“就是轮回。”罗峰也感应到超强的召唤，同时至高规则也传来阵阵波动，显然指引罗峰、原祖进入那轮回内，而且一代代轮回时代传下来的地图，指向的也是这。

“先探测一番。”原祖传音过来。

他们俩开始探测这轮回入口，可是怎么探查都无法知晓其内部情况。

“罗峰，先进，还是我先进？”原祖传音过来。

“我先吧。”罗峰自信很足，自己的星辰塔可是神王兵器，自己又是永恒真神。而且他和原祖必须有一个先进去，总不能让原祖先上吧。

星辰塔缓缓飞行，渐渐的部分开始没入那轮回通道表面的彩光，紧跟着便完全进去了。

“罗峰，罗峰，罗峰。”原祖却是感应不到罗峰了，当即翻出一令牌，这是传讯令牌。

在罗峰的型宇宙内，那可是有罗峰的神力化身的，自然也带着传讯令牌。

“罗峰。”

“原祖。”罗峰神力化身回应了。

“怎么样？”原祖追问道。

“进来吧，没事

罗峰正处于震撼中，他的确没遇到任何危险，而且一进入轮回通道便感觉无比的舒畅。

“这轮回通道。”罗峰站在星辰塔内看着外面，只见一片流光的轮回通道中，无数的一道道模糊影子时而浮现时而消失，有些是人类模样，有些是异兽模样，有些是植物模样，总之千奇百怪，无数的影子正迅速飞过。

“到底怎么回事？”罗峰将摩罗撒安排到另一舱室，随即一翻手，手中出现了那一金晶。

这是坐山客的金晶。

只见金晶上方凝聚出一道身影来，正是坐山客，坐山客微笑着看着外面：“哦，已经进入轮回了？”

“老师。”罗峰看着坐山客，他可有着太多的疑惑，“老师，到底要让我做什么，现在可以了吧。还有老师怎么有九劫秘典的？还有星辰塔，这应该是神王兵器吧。”

“哈哈哈，慢慢来，慢慢来。我们不赶时间。”坐山客哈哈笑着。

罗峰深吸一口气：“老师，。”

“我知道的很多，比想象的要多。”坐山客道，“星辰塔，的确是神王兵器，并且也的确是我炼制的。”

“什么！”罗峰愕然。

坐山客炼制的神王兵器？

难道坐山客是神王？

可是坐山客有型宇宙，这是事实！

“我能炼制出星辰塔，自然是神王，而且是擅长炼制至宝的神王。”坐山客看着罗峰，眼中有着一丝笑意和得意，“我就是晋之神王。”

“晋之神王？”罗峰蒙了。

坐山客怎么会是晋之神王？

自己曾经在晋之世界内鉴定过星辰塔，可是那晋之世界中的‘晋之神王虚幻意识’却根本辨认不出。

“可我在晋之世界中，鉴定过星辰塔了。”罗峰忍不住道。

“别急，且听我慢慢。”坐山客眼眸中有着复杂之色。

罗峰乖乖点头仔细聆听。

他有种感觉，坐山客怕着真就是那位晋之神王。

“先简单下实力划分，接下来的故事也更容易理解。”坐山客道，“从真神开始，真神、虚空真神、永恒真神、混沌主宰、神王。”

“真神到永恒真神，想必都知晓了。”

罗峰乖乖点头。

“永恒真神，一念即可形成型宇宙，他们已经悟出了宇宙的一些本源奥妙。”坐山客道，“比如悟出水火之源，悟出时空之源，悟出光暗之源……只要悟出任何一种，即可成为永恒真神。”

罗峰悟出的是生灭之源。

生灭之源，只是罗峰毁灭之道的开端而已。

“再进一步，便要掌控混沌！”

“各种法则，一切都出自混沌，这才是终极法则。掌控混沌，便是混沌主宰。足以称圣！这一步也无比艰难，不知多少永恒真神无法突破。我当初晋国最辉煌时，麾下永恒真神非常多，可称圣的却十余个而已。”

“一旦掌控了混沌，可将自己的真神之心，衍变成混沌空间，这一切都要自己来催发衍变，所以必须是掌控混沌法则后才能做

罗峰心中一动。

自己也有真神之心，真神之心就是一藏匿着灵魂的空间，沟通型宇宙本源而已。

“拥有了混沌空间后，大量的神力即可储藏其中。”坐山客道，“可积累越来越多的神力。”

“若是再进一步成为神王，境界之高，便可操控体内的混沌空间衍变为一颗型宇宙。”坐山客笑道，“晋之世界，就是我体内开辟出的一颗型宇宙。这颗型宇宙看似，实则可极大，也可孕育出大量强者，只是宇宙的完善强大，一切都要靠自己去推动。”

罗峰惊叹。

像自己的型宇宙，扩张、衍变等等，一切都是自然变化。罗峰自己根本是不懂的。

要在体内开辟出一型宇宙，则必须先化混沌空间，再主动衍变出一颗宇宙来……这就需要对宇宙奥妙的掌握达到不可思议的地步。

“不同的神王，擅长的也不同。”坐山客道，“他们在体内开辟出的型宇宙也会有所区别。像我擅长炼宝，开辟出的宇宙算是比较精致了。有些神王开辟出的宇宙是很粗糙的。”

一个掌控混沌，一个更是能自行开辟宇宙。

旁边坐山客则是继续着。

“真神、虚空真神、永恒真神、称圣、神王。”坐山客道，“其实在神王之上，传还有更高一境界。”

“传到了那一境界，甚至至高规则也无法限制，传中，到了那一境界甚至能制定至高规则。”坐山客眼神中有着期望，“只是我参悟无尽岁月，却怎么都无法跨出那一步。”

“神王之上，真有更高一境界？”罗峰怀疑。

“应该有。”

坐山客道，“比如真正绝对无敌的存在——元！元，应该跨出了那一步。当然关于到了那一境界有多厉害，就纯粹是想象了。”

“元？”罗峰一怔。

自己修炼的《列元术》，创造者不就是元么？

“应该得到了《列元术》了吧。”坐山客笑看着罗峰，“那就是元的绝学！”

“怎么知道？”罗峰惊愕。

即便坐山客真是晋之神王。

Page (1/3)

A Star Tower and a boat are rapidly entering the Qingfeng Realm.

One of them is the Eternal True God, and the other is the Void True God. Naturally, they can easily overcome many obstacles. They have long known the approximate location of 'Reincarnation'.

"Original Ancestor, do you feel the call?" Luo Feng said in a message.

"I feel it, it's just ahead." The original ancestor also sent a message, "According to some maps left by the strong men in the past who went through reincarnation, reincarnation is just ahead."

With the Star Tower in front and the boat behind, they flew to a vast area.

"That's it?" Luo Feng looked into the distance, with Morosa standing beside him.

"That should be reincarnation." Morosa also said.

Luo Feng looked carefully. There was nothingness in the vast space. Only in front of him was a huge channel entrance with colored energy flowing on its surface. At the entrance of the channel, there were vague figures, which seemed to be human beings and beasts. At a glance, hundreds of millions of figures were passing by the entrance of the channel.

"It's reincarnation." Luo Feng also sensed the super powerful summons, and at the same time there were waves of fluctuations in the supreme rules, which obviously guided Luo Feng and the original ancestor to enter that reincarnation, and the maps passed down from generations of reincarnation eras pointed to this.

"Let's do some detection first." The original ancestor came over.

The two of them began to explore the entrance to reincarnation, but no matter how much they explored, they could not find out what was going on inside.

"Luo Feng, should I go first?" the original ancestor said.

"I'll go first." Luo Feng was very confident. His Star Tower was the weapon of the God King, and he was the Eternal True God.And one of him or the original ancestor must go in first, we can't let the original ancestor go in.

The Star Tower flew slowly, and gradually began to partially submerge into the colorful light on the surface of the reincarnation channel, and then completely entered it.

"Luo Feng, Luo Feng, Luo Feng." The original ancestor couldn't sense Luo Feng anymore, so he immediately pulled out a token, which was a communication token.

In Luo Feng's universe, there is an incarnation of Luo Feng's divine power, and naturally it also carries a communication token.

"Luo Feng."

"Original Ancestor." The incarnation of Luo Feng's divine power responded.

"How is it?" the original ancestor asked.

"Come in, it's okay

Luo Feng was in shock. He did not encounter any danger, and he felt extremely comfortable as soon as he entered the reincarnation channel.

"This is the passage of reincarnation."Luo Feng stood in the Star Tower and looked outside. He saw countless vague shadows appearing and disappearing in the samsara passage. Some were human-like, some were alien-like, and some were plants-like. In short, there were all kinds of strange things. Countless shadows were flying quickly.

"What's going on?"Luo Feng arranged Morosa to another cabin, then turned his hand, and the golden crystal appeared in his hand.

This is the golden crystal of Mountain Guest.

I saw a figure condensed above the golden crystal, it was the mountain guest. The mountain guest looked outside with a smile: "Oh, you have entered reincarnation?"

"teacher.Luo Feng looked at the mountain guest. He had too many doubts, "Teacher, what exactly do you want me to do? It's okay now."And why does the teacher have the Secret Book of Nine Tribulations?There is also the Star Tower, which should be the weapon of the God King."

"Hahaha, take your time, take your time.We are not in a hurry."The mountain guest laughed.

Luo Feng took a deep breath: "Teacher,..."

“I know a lot, more than I thought."The mountain guest said, "The Star Tower is indeed the weapon of the God King, and it was indeed refined by me."

"What!"Luo Feng was stunned.

The weapon of the God King refined by the mountain guest?

Could it be that the mountain guest is the king of gods?

But the mountain guest has a unique universe, this is a fact!

"I can refine the Star Tower, so naturally I am a God King, and I am a God King who is good at refining treasures."The mountain guest looked at Luo Feng, with a hint of smile and pride in his eyes, "I am the God King of Jin."

“The God King of Jin?"Luo Feng was confused.

How could the mountain guest be the God King of Jin?

I once identified the Star Tower in the World of Jin, but the 'Illusive Consciousness of the God King of Jin' in the World of Jin could not identify it at all.

“But I have appraised the Star Tower in the world of Jin.Luo Feng couldn't help but said.

"Don't be anxious, just listen to me."There was a complicated look in the mountain guest's eyes.

Luo Feng nodded obediently and listened carefully.

He had a feeling that the mountain guest was afraid that he was really the God King of Jin.

“Let’s briefly divide the strength first, and the following story will be easier to understand."The mountain guest said, "Start with the True God, the True God, the True God of Void, the True God of Eternity, the Lord of Chaos, and the King of Gods."

“From the True God to the Eternal True God, I think they all know it."

Luo Feng nodded obediently.

"The Eternal God can form the universe with just one thought. They have already understood some of the original mysteries of the universe."The mountain guest said, "For example, if you understand the source of water and fire, the source of time and space, the source of light and darkness...as long as you understand any of them, you can become the eternal true god."

What Luo Feng realized was the source of life and death.

The source of life and death is just the beginning of Luo Feng's path of destruction.

“One step further, we must control chaos!"

“All kinds of laws, everything comes from chaos, this is the ultimate law.To control chaos is to be the master of chaos.Enough to be called a saint!This step is also extremely difficult, and I don’t know how many eternal true gods can’t break through.When the Jin Kingdom was at its most glorious, I had many true eternal gods under my command, but only a dozen of them could be called saints."

"Once you control chaos, you can transform your True God's Heart into chaotic space. You have to trigger the transformation yourself, so you must control the law of chaos before you can do it.

Luo Feng's heart moved.

I also have the heart of true God. The heart of true God is just a space where the soul is hidden and the source of the universe is communicated.

"After possessing the chaotic space, a large amount of divine power can be stored in it." Sitting Mountain Guest said, "You can accumulate more and more divine power."

"If you go one step further and become a God King, and your realm is high, you can control the chaotic space in your body to evolve into a universe." Sitting Mountain Guest said with a smile, "The World of Jin is the universe created in my body. This universe may appear to be very large, but it can also breed a large number of strong people. However, for the perfection and power of the universe, everything must be promoted by myself."

Luo Feng was amazed.

Like your own universe, expansion, evolution, etc., everything is a natural change.Luo Feng himself didn't understand at all.

To create a universe within the body, one must first transform the chaotic space, and then actively evolve a universe... This requires an incredible grasp of the mysteries of the universe.

"Different god kings are good at different things." Sishanke said, "The universes they create in their bodies will also be different. For example, I am good at refining treasures, and the universes I create are relatively refined. The universes created by some god kings are very rough."

One controls chaos, and the other can open up the universe on his own.

The mountain guest sitting next to him continued.

"True God, True God of Void, Eternal True God, Saint, God King." The mountain guest said, "Actually, there is a higher realm than God King."

"Once you reach that realm, even the supreme rules cannot limit it. When you reach that realm, you can even formulate supreme rules." There is hope in the eyes of the mountain guest, "It's just that I have been studying for endless years, but I can't take that step no matter what."

"Is there really a higher realm than the God King?" Luo Feng doubted.

"There should be."

The mountain guest said, "For example, the truly invincible existence - Yuan! Yuan should have taken that step. Of course, how powerful it is at that state is purely imaginary."

"Yuan?" Luo Feng was startled.

Isn't the creator of the "Lie Yuan Shu" that I have practiced myself Yuan?

"You should have obtained the "Lie Yuan Shu"." Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Luo Feng with a smile, "That is Yuan's secret skill!"

"How do you know?" Luo Feng was shocked.

Even if Sishanke is really the God King of Jin.
